categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in wind power equipment manufacturing, specifically focusing on offshore wind power equipment zero components. Main business segments include: (1) Wind power equipment manufacturing - producing wind turbine towers, pile foundations, jacket structures, and offshore substations; (2) New energy development - investing in and operating offshore wind farms; (3) Wind power construction and maintenance services. The company serves as a key supplier in the offshore wind power equipment supply chain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced manufacturing technologies for large steel structures including: automated welding technology with high precision control, large conical thick-plate rolling technology, tower body roundness precision control technology, thick-plate buried arc automatic welding and post-processing technology, high-quality and efficient low-cost welding groove technology, and offshore wind turbine tower surface anti-corrosion treatment technology. The company employs flow-line manufacturing mode with standardized processes and utilizes CNC cutting machines, laser cutting machines, CNC plate rolling machines, and digital welding equipment. The company has obtained EN1090 EU welding quality management system certification and ISO3834 international welding quality management system certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves three main customer categories: (1) Wind power construction contractors including China Communications Construction Company, Longyuan Zhenhua, Tianjin Port Navigation, and others; (2) Wind power operators including State Energy Group, China Huaneng, China Datang, China Huadian, State Power Investment, and others; (3) Wind turbine manufacturers including China Shipping Heavy Industry, Shanghai Electric, Goldwind Science & Technology, Envision Energy, and others. The company primarily serves the offshore wind power market in China with products covering 12MW and above power ratings.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across multiple regions in China with production bases in: Jiangsu Province (Rudong, Qidong, Binhai), Shandong Province (Dongying, Weihai/Rushan), Zhejiang Province (Wenzhou), Guangdong Province (Zhanjiang), and Hainan Province (Danzhou). The company's sales coverage includes East China (Jiangsu, Zhejiang), South China (Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian, Hainan), and other coastal provinces. The company is beginning to develop overseas markets with limited current international business.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the wind power supply chain, specifically as a zero-component manufacturer and supplier. The company is positioned between raw material suppliers (steel plate, flanges) and downstream customers (wind power construction contractors, operators, and turbine manufacturers). The company also has downstream integration through investments in wind power generation projects and construction/maintenance services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) 'Two Seas' strategy - combining offshore wind power (海上) with overseas markets (海外); (2) Three business pillars - wind power equipment manufacturing as the main business, with new energy development and wind power construction/maintenance as supporting businesses; (3) Deep-sea wind power development - focusing on deep-water jacket structures, floating foundations, and marine ranching products; (4) Smart manufacturing - implementing intelligent welding workshops, information-based warehousing, and smart management systems; (5) Geographic expansion - establishing 10+ production bases across coastal regions. R&D priorities include large-capacity turbine components, deep-sea equipment, and integrated marine energy solutions.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of wind power equipment components. Revenue recognition occurs when products are delivered to customer-designated locations, inspected, and signed for by customers. The typical payment structure includes: (1) 10% advance payment upon contract signing; (2) 30-40% material preparation payment; (3) 70-85% payment upon delivery; (4) 90-97% payment upon project completion and inspection; (5) 100% final payment (quality assurance funds) within 1-3 years after project completion. The company also generates revenue from other business activities including equipment rental and logistics services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of offshore wind power equipment components. The company has established strong relationships with major wind power operators, construction contractors, and turbine manufacturers. Competitive advantages include technical expertise, quality control, production capacity, and geographic distribution of manufacturing bases. The company faces competition from other domestic wind power equipment manufacturers and potential competition from new entrants. The company's market position is strengthened by its established customer relationships, technical capabilities, and strategic geographic positioning of production facilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized wind power equipment manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 1.354 billion yuan, down 19.63% from 2023 revenue of 1.685 billion yuan. The company achieved net profit of 66.11 million yuan in 2024, recovering from a loss of 88.05 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 9.52 billion yuan at year-end 2024, up 23.23% from 7.73 billion yuan in 2023. The company has experienced significant growth in asset base through capital investments and project development, though recent revenue has declined due to market conditions. The company maintains a strong equity base of 5.41 billion yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through: (1) Advanced manufacturing technology - proprietary welding, rolling, and precision control technologies developed over years of R&D; (2) Quality assurance - comprehensive quality management systems with multiple international certifications (EN1090, ISO3834); (3) Geographic advantage - strategically located production bases near ports enabling efficient logistics and cost reduction; (4) Customer relationships - established partnerships with major industry players providing stable demand; (5) Product range - comprehensive coverage of offshore wind equipment from 12MW+ capacity; (6) Service capability - integrated services including design optimization, technical support, and after-sales maintenance; (7) Innovation focus - continuous development of deep-sea and floating foundation technologies for next-generation offshore wind projects.
